description: This file defines SCIM (System for Cross-domain Identity Management) data models and schemas using Pydantic for validation, including user, group, list response, patch operations, and service provider configuration models.

classes.name: SCIMResource
classes.description: Base model for SCIM resources with schema, id, externalId, and meta fields

classes.name: SCIMUserName
classes.description: Model representing a user's name components

classes.name: SCIMUserEmail
classes.description: Model representing a user's email with validation

classes.name: SCIMUserGroup
classes.description: Model representing a user group with ID, display name, and type

classes.name: SCIMUser
classes.description: Model representing a SCIM user, extending SCIMResource

classes.name: SCIMMember
classes.description: Model representing a group member with user ID and display info

classes.name: SCIMGroup
classes.description: Model representing a SCIM group, extending SCIMResource

classes.name: SCIMListResponse
classes.description: Model for SCIM list responses containing resources and pagination info

classes.name: SCIMPatchOperation
classes.description: Model for individual SCIM patch operations with validation for 'op' field

classes.name: SCIMPatchOp
classes.description: Model for a list of patch operations

classes.name: SCIMFeature
classes.description: Model representing features supported by the SCIM service provider

classes.name: SCIMServiceProviderConfig
classes.description: Model for SCIM service provider configuration including supported features

methods.name: normalize_op
methods.description: Validator to normalize and validate the 'op' field in SCIMPatchOperation
